title: Mike McDaniel: We'll kinda play hot hand at running back

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Mike McDaniel: We'll kinda play hot hand at running back
sources.description: Chargers running back Omarion Hampton thinks the arrival of offensive coordinator Mike McDaniel is going to be a good thing for the team's running backs and McDaniel's plans for the position came up during a press conference on Monday.
